mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_TAG_DEFINITION (ID, CODE, NAME, CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, AUTO_APPROVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{description}, #{status}, #{autoApprove}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PT_TAG_DEFINITION ORDER BY CATEGORY, CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_TAG_DEFINITION SET NAME = #{name}, CATEGORY = #{category}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, AUTO_APPROVE = #{autoApprove}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE PT_TAG_DEFINITION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_TAG_RULE (ID, TAG_ID, KEYWORD, NORMALIZED_KEYWORD, STATUS, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{tagId}, #{keyword}, #{normalizedKeyword}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TAG_ID, KEYWORD, NORMALIZED_KEYWORD, STATUS, VERSION_NO AS VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_TAG_RULE SET STATUS = #{status}, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TAG_ID, KEYWORD, NORMALIZED_KEYWORD, STATUS, VERSION_NO AS VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE WHERE TAG_ID = #{tagId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT

SELECT R.ID AS RULE_ID, R.TAG_ID, R.KEYWORD, CASE WHEN T.AUTO_APPROVE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS AUTO_APPROVE FROM PT_TAG_RULE R INNER JOIN PT_TAG_DEFINITION T ON T.ID = R.TAG_ID WHERE R.STATUS = 1 AND T.STATUS = 1 ORDER BY R.ID
